chapters.title: 先假设零假设成立，再放入观测
chapters.en: Locate the observation under the null model.

chapters.title: 两侧更极端的区域，加起来是 p 值
chapters.en: A two-sided p-value counts both extreme tails.

chapters.title: 显著性阈值，先于这次数据规定
chapters.en: The significance level specifies a rejection rule.

chapters.title: p 值不是零假设为真的概率
chapters.en: A p-value is not the probability that the null is true.
